rules.statement: Don't report a commit subject as misdescribing its change by comparing it with the pull request's overall diff against the default branch; check what that commit changed on its own, since a later commit (such as a merge that renumbers the release) may explain the difference.
rules.why: The commit that wrote the 0.73.0 changelog section was correct. The overall diff showed 0.74.0 only because a later merge commit renumbered the release, and rewording a pushed commit would need a force-push, which the repository ruleset refuses.
rules.check: Before flagging a commit subject, run `git show <commit>` on that commit alone and look at later commits in the branch, such as a renumber or merge commit, that changed the same lines.
